messages:
alyssa: Heads up — planning the v2 -> v3 header rollforward next week. Need a decision on fallback routing + quota attribution. If a client sets X-RW-API: v3 but we lack capacity, do we auto-route to v2, 429, or something else? Also want console UX for per-tenant fallback opt-in. Thoughts?

sam: Leaning toward automatic fallback to v2 for most traffic to avoid user-facing errors. Emit metric route.fallback.v3_to_v2 with tag fallback_reason=capacity.

ben: Cost/billing question — v2 and v3 token pricing differ. If we silently fallback, tenants could get billed unexpectedly. Do we map tokens to the v3 billing profile even when served by v2 model variant?

mira: We currently lack deterministic mapping for some newer models. Implementing a full mapping in 48h is tight. Alternative: return soft-429 with Retry-After and a telemetry event so clients can surface a friendly message.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2024-05-12T22:00Z on tenanted-shadow for 5% traffic.

jordan: Console idea: show a compat-mode badge and let tenant admins choose default behavior (allow-fallback / strict). Show counts and cost-delta preview before they flip the toggle.

alyssa: Agree on per-tenant toggle. Sam, can we emit an event histogram for tail latency when fallback occurs? Need to verify SLA impact.

sam: Yes — add telemetry.route.latency_ms with label fallback=yes/no and trace tag route.variant. Also emit route.fallback.count by tenant and region.

ben: From billing side, we need a clear contract. Mapping billing to v3 while serving v2 could cause legal/regression issues. I'll loop in @finance. If mapping is ambiguous, prefer 429 for external customers.

mira: Ops concern — if fallback triggers a cascade across regions, v2 could saturate. Propose using a circuit breaker that limits fallback throughput and ramps down automatically.

ops: We already have a runtime flag fallback_rate_limit that can be toggled per-region. Will prepare a test plan for canary.

alyssa: Proposal: default allow-fallback for internal/testing tenants with telemetry; default strict (429) for external tenants unless they opt-in in console. If mapping exists, apply billing mapping; if unmapped, respond 429 and record fallback.unmapped for reconciliation.

jordan: UX microcopy: 'Fallback to previous API version may change latency and cost. Admins can opt-in to allow automatic fallback.' Also add a preview modal that estimates cost delta.

mira: I'll implement runtime guard + add a short log marker fallback.unmapped and emit a metric for unmapped fallback attempts. Opening PR and linking to canary.

ben: I'll coordinate with finance and billing UI to show a placeholder tag when mapping is unresolved. We can surface a billing reconciliation ticket in the invoice UI.

sam: I'll add a dashboard panel: fallback rate, latency delta, cost delta per tenant. Query skeleton: sum(rate(route.fallback.count[5m])) by (tenant) and histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(telemetry.route.latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (fallback).

alyssa: Action items recap: mira = runtime guard + logs, sam = telemetry + dashboard, jordan = console toggle + preview modal, ben = finance mapping + billing tags. Aim for code freeze + canary by Wednesday. Reply with +1 if ok.

mira: +1 — opening PR #3456 for fallback-guard, ETA Tue EOD. Will attach canary config.

sam: +1, will start dashboard ticket.

jordan: +1, will prototype toggle and modal copy.

ben: +1, pinging finance and adding billing flagging work item.
